title: Apache ECharts Migration: Highcharts Licence Map
description: Finds every Highcharts package, NuGet reference, import and CDN tag in package.json, .csproj, HTML or JS/TS, quotes the EULA clause and gives the exact Apache ECharts line that replaces it.
